info.title: SAPIENT ROYAL MAIL API
info.description:
# Introduction
Here you will find requirements for integrating with SAPIENT ROYAL MAIL API.

The documentation specifically covers how the API can be used by business customers to conduct shipping activity with available carriers and provides the technical information to build this integration. The API allows customers to create and manage shipments, produce labels, customs documentation, and collection manifests, retrieve reference data such as carriers and countries, and maintain their own data such as shipping account details.

Intersoft API is a fully RESTful service implemented using JSON messaging. You, as the customer are responsible for sending JSON messages and for maintaining the capability of receiving JSON messages in the format described in this specification. Request and response examples for each API service are included in this specification.

# Authentication

The SAPIENT ROYAL MAIL API uses OAuth2 authentication.

To request the authorization token you need to create API credentials (Client ID and Secret) on the system first. If you have not done it already, log into your account and go to API Credentials or follow the link [add a link here with the path to the API Credentials menu]. Use the credentials to retrieve the authorization token.

Note: Make sure you copy the Secret and keep it secure as you won't be able to view it again on the system.

LocationAlias.description: A user-defined identifier for the shipping location. This information allows greater flexibility in recognising and referring to the location.

Timezone.description: The timezone in which the shipping location is located, important for scheduling and logistical considerations.

IsDefaultLocation.description:
A boolean value indicating whether the shipping location is set as the default for shipping operations, streamlining the selection process during shipments.
If the location is set as the default one, the customers no longer need to specify the location for every shipment request, reducing the risk of errors and delays. It enhances consistency by ensuring that all shipments are directed to the same default location.

***Note:** If true, then this location is set as the default one. Otherwise, it is set to false.*

ShippingAccountId.description: A unique identifier for the shipping account assigned by the system, allowing for efficient reference and management of individual accounts within the system.

ShippingLocationId.description:
A unique identifier assigned to the new shipping location by the system. This ID is used to distinguish between different shipping locations within the system, facilitating, referencing and operations, such as updates, deletions, or specific queries related to that location.

***Note:** This field is only populated if the details of a new location were provided in the request.*

AddressId.description:
A unique identifier for the address associated with the shipping location. This ID serves as a reference point, allowing users to easily access, manage, and differentiate between different addresses stored in the system.

***Note:** This ID is stored in the system's address book. If this information is provided, then all the fields under the **Address** object are ignored and the stored address in the **Address Book** will be used.*

Line1.description:
The first line of the address, typically containing the primary address information such as house number and street name.

***Note:** Characters like +, /, -, or space are supported.*

Line2.description: An optional second line for the address, often used for additional details like apartment numbers or suite designations.

Line3.description: A third optional line in the address to include any further address specifications, allowing for more detailed address information if necessary.

Town.description:
The town or city, indicating the specific locality where the shipping location is situated.

***Note:** This information is required if the address is not used from the stored addresses in the **Address Book**.*

Postcode.description:
The postal or ZIP code corresponding to the shipping location, used for mail sorting and to identify specific geographic areas.

***Note:** This information is only required for the addresses in the UK and for some outside it. To check for the postcode requirements, refer to the **Countries** API.*

County.description:
The county, state, or province in which the shipping location resides, providing additional geographical context for the address.

***Note:** This information may be required depending on the country. If the country is USA, Australia, or Canada, then it must be a valid state code or name, respectively. To check for the county/state/province requirements, refer to the **Countries** API.*

CountryCode.description:
An abbreviation representing the country of the shipping location, following the ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 standard, for example, "GB" for the United Kingdom.

***Note**: This information is only required if the address is not used from the stored addresses in the **Address Book***

What3Words.description: A three-word location identifier provided by the What3words service, offering a precise way to define locations using a unique combination of three words, for example, the front door of 10 Downing Street in London is identified by slurs.this.shark.

ContactPhone.description:
The contact phone number associated with the shipping location, facilitating communication regarding shipments or deliveries.

***Note:** Characters like +, /, -, or space are supported.*

AddShippingLocationAddress.description: The complete address of the shipping location, consisting of multiple components including street information, locality, and so on.

BusinessTransactionType.description:
Specifies the nature of the commercial transaction type associated with the shipment.

Valid values are:
  • **B2C** - Business to Consumer
  • **B2B** - Business to Business
  • **D2C** - Direct 2 Consumer
  • **C2B** - Consumer to Business

Reference1.description: The shipper's reference for this shipment

ContentType.description:
Defines the type of contents being shipped. This helps the carrier manage the shipment according to its content type.

Valid values are:

**NDX** (Non Documents)
**DOX** (Documents)
**HV** (Non Documents of High Value)

SlotReservationId.description: The SlotReservationId returned in the Get Collection Timeslots response

SlotDate.description: The collection date selected from the available slots in the Get Collection Timeslots response

BringMyLabel.description:
If true, Royal Mail will bring the Label and Custom Declaration if required.
Defaults to false

OptOutFromRmNotifications.description:
Indicates whether the Royal Mail collection notifications are sent to the consignee or not.

The accepted values are the following:
  • **true** — Royal Mail will not send the collection notifications to the consignee, allowing customers to send their own branded notifications instead.
  • **false** — Royal Mail will send the collection notifications to the consignee.

***Note:** By default, this field is set to false.*

CollectionSafePlace.description: Provides details about a designated safe place location where Royal Mail can securely collect the parcel—for example, behind the bin or in the porch. This ensures that the collection can proceed smoothly if the primary location is inaccessible or no one is home.

CollectionDate.description: The date the collection has been booked for

CreateShipmentAction.description:
Indicates the operation to be performed for the shipment, determines the shipment status that is set on shipment creation and whether a shipment tracking number and labels are generated.

Valid values are:
  • **Process:** Creates a shipment tracking number, generates and prints a label for each package in the shipment, and returns the labels in the createShipment response. With this action, the shipment status is set to Ready to Manifest.
  • **Create:** Creates the shipment but does not allocate a tracking number, print the labels or return them in the createShipment response. The label(s) must be printed before the shipment is ready to manifest.
  • **Allocate:** Creates the tracking number and label but does not print the labels or return them in the createShipment response. The label(s) must be printed before the shipment is ready to manifest.

***Note**: By default, this field is set to Process.*
*Please be advised that if the shipment is created using a consignment service (shipments with multiple packages) with a partner carrier—via the **Create** or **Allocate** actions—then the system will split the packages into multiple individual shipments without generating the consignment number.*

ReasonForExport.description:
Identifies the purpose of the export, such as sale, gift, or return. This information is useful for customs processing to determine the appropriate tariffs and requirements.
This field is mandatory for Royal Mail international shipments.
The following values are accepted:
  • Gift
  • Commercial Sample
  • Documents
  • Sale of Goods
  • Return of Goods
  • Mixed Content
  • Other

PreRegistrationNumber.description:
A number for tax pre-registration in countries where required for compliance during DDU shipments.

If applicable, this number is required for countries operating a Tax Pre-Registration scheme(for example, VOEC in Norway, GST in Australia) when shipping under DDU Incoterms.If not provided and DDU is specified, any pre-registration numbers configured in the Customs Settings GUI for the account will be used.

***Note:** VAT and EORI numbers should be provided in the Shipper and receiver **VatNumber** and **EoriNumber** fields, not in this field.*

PreRegistrationType.description:
The type of pre-registration number provided in the PreRegistrationNumber element, specifying the registration scheme type. This field is mandatory if a PreRegistrationNumber is provided. Otherwise, it is ignored.

***Note:** VAT and EORI numbers should be provided in the Shipper and receiver **VatNumber** and **EoriNumber** fields, not in this field.*

ShippingCharges.description: The postage amount paid by the customer for the international shipments, which can be 0.00 if free delivery is offered. This amount is used for calculating customs fees and should be in the currency specified in the **ShipmentInformation** > **Currency** field.

OtherCharges.description: The additional costs charged to the customer beyond standard shipping, such as insurance fees. This field can be left blank or set to 0.00 if no additional charges apply. Values should be in the currency specified in the **ShipmentInformation** > **Currency** field.

QuotedLandedCost.description:
The total cost quoted to the customer when the shipment reaches the destination, including duties and taxes, and must be expressed in the currency specified in the **ShipmentInformation** > **Currency** field.

***Note:** This information is required for some international destinations when the shipment incoterms are DDP.*

InvoiceNumber.description:
A specific number that is associated with a shipment. This is useful for tracking, billing, and reconcilliation purposes.

***Note:** When sending an item to an overseas address and a Commercial or Proforma invoice is available, the **InvoiceNumber** and **InvoiceDate** should be provided to support customs processing.If provided, it will be displayed on commercial invoices generated for the shipment.Please be advised that this field is required if the **InvoiceDate** is provided.*

InvoiceDate.description:
The date on which the invoice was created. This information is useful for record-keeping, billing cycles, and tracking payment due dates.

***Note:** The InvoiceDate must be in the YYYY-MM-DD format.This field is ignored if the **InvoiceNumber** is not provided. If the **InvoiceNumber** is provided without the invoice date, then the **InvoiceDate** defaults to today's date.*

ExportLicenceRequired.description:
A boolean flag indicating whether an export license is needed for the shipment, particularly for goods predominantly used for military purposes. If required, the export license should be affixed to the outside of the package.

***Note:** To learn more about the types of items requiring an export license, refer to the UK Government website.*

Airn.description:
The AIRN (Address Identification Reference Number) is the generic name given to a national identification number for the overseas recipient of an item. This is required by certain countries for customs clearance.

***Note:** If the AIRN is available, then it should be provided for items being exported to countries where the customs/tax authority requests one, such as Russia and Brazil.*

Customs.description: Used to provide information for customs clearance related to the shipment. This includes, reasons for export, applicable incoterms, any pre-registration numbers and type required, shipping and other charges, as well as details about the invoice and whether an export license is needed. It ensures compliance with international shipping regulations.

EoriNumber.description:
The EORI (Economic Operators Registration and Identification) number for the receiver, which must start with the ISO Alpha-2 Country Code followed by up to 15 alphanumeric characters. For Northern Ireland, it starts with XI.

***Note:** Make sure to provide this information here—not in the **Customs** object.*

VatNumber.description:
The VAT (Value Added Tax) number for the receiver, which, if applicable, is used for tax compliance.

***Note:** Make sure to provide this information here—not in the **Customs** object.*

Destination.description: An object providing details on the shipment destination, such as receiver and contact details.

AddressId.description:
A unique identifier for the address. This information ensures that each address can be distinctly referenced and managed within the system.

***Note:** If this information is provided, then all the fields under the **Address** object are ignored and the stored address in the **Address Book** will be used.*

PudoId.description:
A unique identifier for a PUDO location. This ID is retrieved from the LocationId field of the Get PUDO Locations endpoint response and is essential for identifying the specific collection point for a Royal Mail shipment.
Note: Before providing the PudoId, keep in mind the following:
- The PudoId is only applicable for destination addresses when the shipment is being created as a collection shipment. Royal Mail does not utilise this ID for drop-off shipments.
- The destination contact name must be provided with either its contact email or phone number.
- The LocalCollect supplement code is not required - the system will automatically assign the relevant supplement codes based on the PudoId.

The total number of packages in the container

Shipments.description:
Shipment Details
The shipments assigned to the container. Only populated if 'returnShipments' was set to true in the request query parameters.

ManifestNumbers.description: Manifest Numbers. Only populated if the container has been manifested.

UNCode.description:
The United Nations (UN) code assigned to the hazardous material, which denotes its classification for transport. This code is critical for safety and compliance during shipping.
***Note:** This field must be populated only for domestic shipments using class 9 dangerous goods. If provided, then **Quantity** and **UnitOfMeasure** must also be specified.*

ProperShippingName.description: Proper Shipping Name of the hazardous item being shipped.

Class.description: Mandatory if Hazmat information is provided. Used to provide the class number of the hazardous item being shipped.

Id8000Category.description:
If the hazardous goods class is 9, an applicable ID8000 category is required.
If ID8000 category is provided with any hazardous goods class other than class 9, it will be ignored.
Available values are:
- Medicines
- Perfume/Aftershave
- Nail Varnish
- Toiletry or Medicinal Aerosols

If a customer sends a Create Shipment request with the ID8000Category field populated and the Class field is populated with any value other than class 9,
the ID8000Category will be ignored and the data will not be saved on the shipment record.
If a customer sends a Create Shipment request with the ID8000Category field populated and the Class field is populated with 9,
the system will behave as it does currently (create the Product and save the ID8000 data to the product record)

Quantity.description:
The quantity of the hazardous material in the specified UnitOfMeasure. This information is vital for compliance with shipping regulations pertaining to hazardous materials.
***Note:** This field is only required if **UnitOfMeasure** and **UNCode** is specified.*

EmergencyActionCode.description: Emergency Action Code of the hazardous item.

HazchemNumber.description: The Hazchem Number of the item.

SpecialistAdviceContactNumber.description:
The specialist advice phone number to contact if there are any issues with the hazardous item.
If not provided, when a hazardous stored product is used in create shipment request, the phone number will be set from the customer shipping account record.

PrintId8000Label.description:
A boolean field that provides customers with the choice to generate the ID8000 label along with the shipping label. When set to true, the system returns the ID8000 labels for class 9 hazardous products contained within the shipment. By default, this field is set to false.

***Note:** Before populating this field, keep in mind the following:
  • This field is ignored if the **Action** field is populated with values other than **Process**.
  • The ID8000 label is returned in the PDF format only.*

HazmatUnitOfMeasure.description:
The unit of measurement for the quantity of hazardous material, for example, litres (for liquids) or kilograms (for solids). This provides clarity regarding the amount of hazardous goods present.
***Note:** This field is only required if **Quantity** and **UNCode** is specified.*

ContainerId.description:
Container Id
The Container Name/Alias for this container
Defaults to a globally unique identifier.

ShippingLocationAlias.description:
Shipping Location
The shipping location name/alias that this container is for. Only shipments created for this location can be added to this container.

ShippingLocationId.description:
Shipping Location Id
The assigned Id for this location.

DestinationCountryCode.description:
Destination Country Code
2 Digit ISO Country Code, per ISO 3166 Standard

ExportDate.description:
Export Date
Automatically set when a container is finalised
Format YYYY-MM-DD

Mawb.description:
MAWB
Master Airway Bill number. Must be provided in the following format: nnn-nnnnnnnn.
Must be provided prior to manifesting the container in order for the shipments in the container to be manifested successfully.

RmOeCode.description:
RM OE Code
Royal Mail OE Code
Defaults to GBR

TotalWeight.description:
Total Weight
The total weight of all the shipments currently added to the container.

TotalShipments.description:
Total Shipments
The total number of shipments in the container.

TotalPackages.description:
Total Packages
The total number of packages in the container

Containers.description:
Containers
The containers for the requested page only.

TotalCount.description:
Total Count
The total number of containers available

InternationalArrivalsContainersPagedResp.description: The paged response containing the entities for the requested page only, and the total number available.

SkuCode.description: A unique Stock Keeping Unit (SKU) code assigned to the item. This code is used for tracking inventory, helping users identify specific items easily.

PackageOccurrence.description:
A unique identifier for each package within the shipment that is used to assign items to a specific package.

***Note:** The package occurence provided here must exist on one of the packages in the **Packages** object. If multiple packages exist and a consignment service is not used, this field is mandatory to ensure each package occurrence is distinct.*

Quantity.description: The quantity of this item in the package being shipped.

Description.description:
A brief summary providing details about the specifc item being shipped, outlining its type, features, uses, and any pertinent information that helps users understand the item, such as 'skirt' instead of 'ladies clothing.'

***Note:** This information is mandatory for dutiable shipments unless a SKU Code of a stored product is provided.If a SKU Code of a stored product is present and this field is left blank, it will be automatically populated from the stored product; if both are provided, the input in this field takes precedence.*

Value.description:
The monetary value of a single instance of the item, in the currency specified in the **CurrencyCode** field.

***Note:** This information is mandatory for dutiable shipments unless a SKU Code of a stored product is provided.If a SKU Code of a stored product is present and this field is left blank, it will be automatically populated from the stored product; if both are provided, the input in this field takes precedence.*

Weight.description:
The weight of a single instance of the item, in the unit of measure specified in the **WeightUnitOfMeasure** field. This is required for dutiable shipments unless a SKU Code from the stored product is used. If the SKU Code is available and the weight is left blank, it will be populated from the stored product; otherwise, the provided weight will be used.

***Note:** The maximum allowed weight is 1000 KG.For non-dutiable shipments, a weight of 0 is accepted.For dutiable shipments, an item weight of 1 gram or greater must be provided.*

ImageURL.description: This field provides the URL of the product image with the shipment details. This helps customers visually identify the product when selecting items for return in the Returns system.

HSCode.description:
The Harmonized System (HS) code used by customs to determine potential duties and taxes for the product. This code ranges from 6 to 13 alphanumeric characters, depending on specific services or destinations. Some countries may also use the HS codes of other character lengths.

***Note:** Characters like space and dot are supported.*

For more information on HS Codes and to find the correct HS Codes for your items, refer to the following link: https://www.gov.uk/trade-tariff

CountryOfOrigin.description:
An abbreviation representing the country where the item was manufactured or produced, following the ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 standard, for example, "GB" for the United Kingdom. This information is important for customs declarations and compliance with import/export regulations.

***Note:** Depending on the carrier and destination country, this information may be required for dutiable shipments.*

SupplementaryUnits.description:
This field specifies any additional unit of measurements that supplement the primary unit of measurements for the item being shipped.
For example: The HS code for PVC Black Flooring Roll 2.5mm is 391890. HMRC/Tariff determines that you provide a supplementary unit in square metres (MTK) with HS code 391890.

*Note: For B2B shipments to Northern Ireland, this field is optional if the HMRC/Tariff determines that the Tariff/Harmonisation Code provided requires a supplementary unit.*
*You can enter values to a maximum of 6 decimal places.*

Item.description:
Used to provide details of the items sent in the shipment package(s).
Item information is optional for domestic and non-dutiable shipments, but required for dutiable shipments.
If item information is provided, this element must be repeated for each unique item in the shipment.

ShippingLocationId.description:
Shipping Location the shipment is being shipped from. This can be populated with either the Shipping Location ID assigned by SAPIENT or the Shipping Location Alias set when the Shipping Location was created. Both can be viewed in the Shipping Location GUI.
Mandatory if there is more than one Shipping Location available for the Shipping Account

ShippingAccountId.description: Shipping Account the shipment is being created for. This can be populated with either the Shipping Account ID assigned by SAPIENT Shipping Account ID or the Shipping Account Alias set when the Shipping Account was created.Both can be viewed in the Shipping Account GUI.

ServiceCode.description: The code of the shipping service used to deliver the shipment.

ServiceLevel.description:
The Royal Mail service level of the service specified in the ServiceCode field.
Valid values are 01-99.
Defaults to lowest service level available for the specified service if not provided.

PreAllocateTrackingNumberRequest.description: Royal Mail Get Pre Allocated Tracking Number Request

PreAllocateTrackingNumberResponse.description: Royal Mail Get Pre Allocated Tracking Number Response

ReturnToSender.description: Used to provide the address details to be used when returning the shipment back to the sender.

AddressId.description:
A unique identifier for the address. This information ensures that each address can be distinctly referenced and managed within the system.

***Note:** If this information is provided, then all the fields under the **Address** object are ignored and the stored address in the **Address Book** will be used.*

PudoId.description:
A unique identifier for a PUDO location. This ID is retrieved from the LocationId field of the Get PUDO Locations endpoint response and is essential for identifying the specific collection point for a Royal Mail shipment.
Note: Before providing the PudoId, keep in mind the following:
- The PudoId is only applicable for destination addresses when the shipment is being created as a collection shipment. Royal Mail does not utilise this ID for drop-off shipments.
- The destination contact name must be provided with either its contact email or phone number.
- The LocalCollect supplement code is not required - the system will automatically assign the relevant supplement codes based on the PudoId.

ContactName.description:
The name of the primary contact person for the shipment at the address.

***Note:** Either the **Contact Name** or **Company Name** must be provided.*

CompanyName.description:
The name of the company associated with the shipment at the address.

***Note:** Either the **Contact Name** or **Company Name** must be provided.*

ContactEmail.description: The email address of the contact person for any communication regarding the shipment at the address.

ContactPhone.description:
The contact phone number associated with the return to sender address, facilitating communication regarding shipments or deliveries.

***Note:** Characters like +, /, -, or space are supported.*

Line1.description:
The first line of the address, typically containing the primary address information such as house number and street name.

***Note:** Characters like +, /, -, or space are supported.*

Line2.description: An optional second line for the address, often used for additional details like apartment numbers or suite designations.

Line3.description: A third optional line in the address to include any further address specifications, allowing for more detailed address information if necessary.

Town.description:
The town or city, indicating the specific locality where the shipping location is situated.

***Note:** This information is required if the address is not used from the stored addresses in the **Address Book**.*

Postcode.description:
The postal or ZIP code corresponding to the shipping location, used for mail sorting and to identify specific geographic areas.

***Note:** This information is only required for the addresses in the UK and for some outside it. To check for the postcode requirements, refer to the **Countries** API.*

County.description:
The county, state, or province in which the shipping location resides, providing additional geographical context for the address.

***Note:** This information may be required depending on the country. If the country is USA, Australia, or Canada, then it must be a valid state code or name, respectively. To check for the county/state/province requirements, refer to the **Countries** API.*

CountryCode.description:
An abbreviation representing the country of the shipping location, following the ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 standard, for example, "GB" for the United Kingdom.

***Note**: This information is only required if the address is not used from the stored addresses in the **Address Book***

What3Words.description: A three-word location identifier provided by the What3words service, offering a precise way to define locations using a unique combination of three words, for example, the front door of 10 Downing Street in London is identified by slurs.this.shark.

ReturnToSenderAddress.description: The complete address of the return to sender location, consisting of multiple components including street information, locality, and so on.

RmContentFormat.description:
RM Content Format
Accepted values are:
**G** = Large
**P** = Small

RmProduct.description:
RM Product
If not supplied the system will apply the default.
Accepted values are:
**T** - International Tracked (Default)
**R** - International Tracked and Signed, International Signed
**O** - International Max Sort

RmService.description:
RM Service
If not supplied the system will apply the default.
Accepted values are:
**P** - Priority (Default)
**E** - Economy
**S** - Surface

ShippingLocationId.description: This field is used to link an existing shipping location to the new shipping account that is being created, and either the shipping location Id or alias can be provided to link the shipping location to the shipping account.

PostingLocationCode.description:
Posting Location Code
The number assigned to this Location by Royal Mail.

ObaAccessCode.description:
OBA Access Code
A password for the account to access the OBA services.
A Royal Mail shipping account cannot be active unless the OBA Access code has been provided.

ReceivingHubCode.description:
Receiving Hub Code
Receiving Hub/Regional Distribution Center used for this Shipping Location.
Must be an existing receiving hub code.
Please refer to Royal Mail ReceivingHubs for a list of possible receiving hubs.
If the receiving hub is not provided, we will match it to the one that corresponds to the postcode of the location's address.

RoyalMailAddShippingAccountLocation.description: Royal Mail Add Shipping Account Location

AccountNumber.description:
Carrier Account Number
The account number given by the carrier.

AccountName.description:
The official name of the shipping account as designated by the user or organisation, aiding in easy identification and reference of accounts.

***Note:** By default, this value is set to the customer name if not provided in the request.*

AccountRegisteredEmail.description:
Account Registered Email
This is the email that was used to register your Shipping Account with the carrier when the Shipping Account was created.

AccountAlias.description: A unique, user-defined name for the shipping account, providing a convenient way to reference the account in a more memorable manner.

RegisteredBillingPostcode.description:
The postcode associated with the billing address for the shipping account.
This postcode is used by Royal Mail for sending invoices and other relevant billing communications related to the account.
*
**Note:** This field is mandatory only if the **AccountType** field is set to **Production**.*

ContactName.description:
The name of the primary contact person for the shipping account, facilitating communication regarding shipping and account-related matters.

***Note:** If the shipper address is not provided in the Create Shipment request, this information is used as the shipper's contact name, if provided.*

ContactNumber.description:
The phone number associated with the shipping account's primary contact person, facilitating communication regarding shipping inquiries, account management, and issue resolution.

***Note:** If the shipper address is not provided in the Create Shipment request, this information is used as the shipper's contact phone number, if provided. Characters like +, /, -, or space are supported.*

ShippingLocations.description:
An object that allows the customer to specify the shipping location(s) that will be associated with the new shipping account. Within this object, the customer can either link the existing shipping location(s) or add a new one.

***Note:** While adding a shipping account, make sure to provide at least one shipping location.If you are providing a new shipping location, then only one location can be added.*

RoyalMailAddShippingAccountRequest.description: Royal Mail Add Shipping Account Request

Primary2DBarcodeImage.description:
Primary 2D Barcode Image
Base64 Encoded PNG Image of the 2D data matrix barcode.

Primary2DBarcodeData.description:
Primary 2D Barcode Data - Base 64 Encoded
Data required to create your own 2D data matrix barcode. Please decode before use.

FormattedUniqueId.description:
Formatted Unique Id
Label for 2D data matrix barcode.

SecondaryRoutingCode.description:
Represents the secondary routing code that can be used to refine the addressing of shipments to the correct depot.

***Note**: Please be advised that either the **SecondaryRoutingCode** or the **Part4** gazetteer code, or neither, will be returned in the response.*

Primary1DBarcodeImage.description:
Primary 1D Barcode Image
Only populated where the service requires the barcode on the label.
Base64 Encoded PNG Image of the barcode.

Primary1DBarcodeData.description:
Primary 1D Barcode Data
Only populated where the service requires the barcode on the label.
Data required to create your own barcode.

HighVolumeBarcodeImage.description:
High Volume Barcode Image
Only populated where the service (Tracked High Volume) requires the barcode on the label.
Base64 Encoded PNG Image of the barcode.

HighVolumeBarcodeData.description:
High Volume Barcode Data
Only populated where the service (Tracked High Volume) requires the barcode on the label.
Data required to create your own barcode.

RoyalMailDataStreamDetails.description:
DATASTREAM Details
The information needed to create your own label.
Only present if DATASTREAM label format was specified.

SkuCode.description:
The SKU code of the item the enhanced customs information is being provided for.
The SKU code provided here must also be provided in the Items object, in order to associate the enhanced customs information with the standard item information for the item.
Mandatory if any enhancedCustomsInformation fields are populated.

LicenseNumber.description: Sender's License Number for the item specified in the skuCode field, when applicable to the item being shipped. E.g. Health certificate or controlled goods.

CertificateNumber.description: Sender's Certificate Number for the item specified in the skuCode field, when applicable to the item being shipped. E.g. Health certificate or controlled goods.

OriginPreferenceCode.description:
Can be used to indicate the item is eligible for a preferential duty rate.
Accepted values:
300 – Preferential treatment is applied to the item.
100 or blank – Preferential treatment is not applied to the item.

RoyalMailEnhancedCustomsInformation.description: Enhanced Customs Information for Royal Mail shipments

RoyalMailEnhancementCode.description:
Enhancement code of the service enhancement. Valid values are:
**CL1** - Consequential Loss £1000
**CL2** - Consequential Loss £2500
**CL3** - Consequential Loss £5000
**CL4** - Consequential Loss £7500
**CL5** - Consequential Loss £10000 (Only 1 type of Consequential Loss is allowed)
**Signed** - a signature is required on delivery of the shipment. Can be used with 24, 48, 1st Class and 2nd Class services.
**SMS** - delivery updates will be sent via SMS. Can be used with Special Delivery Guaranteed, Tracked and Tracked High Volume services.
**Email** - delivery updates will be sent via email. Can be used with Special Delivery Guaranteed, Tracked and Tracked High Volume, International Tracked and International Tracked and Signed services.
**Safeplace** - the shipment will be left in a specified safeplace location. The location must be provided in the SafeplaceLocation field. Can be used with Tracked, Tracked High Volume and 24/48 services.
**LocalCollect** - the shipment will be delivered to a Post Office for collection by the receiver. Can be used with Special Delivery Guaranteed, Tracked and Tracked High Volume services.
**CustomsEmail** - Receiver email address will be used in eCustoms data. Can be used with International services.
**CustomsPhone** - Receiver phone number will be used in eCustoms data. Can be used with International services.

Part1.description: Represents the first part of the gazetteer code which is the outward part of the postcode. This code is crucial for routing shipments to a broader geographical region before it it sorted to specific delivery points.

Part2.description: Represents the second part of the inward gazetteer code in a post code. It provides additional specificity for the delivery location and is used together with the outward code to pinpoint exact addresses.

Part3.description: Represents additional components of the inward code to provide further details, enhancing accuracy of shipment delivery.

Part4.description:
Represents additional components of the inward code to provide further details, enhancing accuracy of shipment delivery.

***Note**: Please be advised that either the **Part4** gazetteer code or **SecondaryRoutingCode**, or neither, will be returned in the response.*

ShippingLocationId.description: This can be populated with either the Shipping Location ID assigned by SAPIENT or the Shipping Location Alias set when the Shipping Location was created. Optional if the shipping account only has one Shipping Location assigned. If the Shipping Account has multiple Shipping Locations, then this field must be populated.

ShippingAccountId.description: Shipping Account the number range is being requested for. This can be populated with either the Shipping Account ID assigned by SAPIENT or the Shipping Account Alias set when the Shipping Account was created.

ServiceLevel.description:
The Royal Mail service level of the service specified in the ServiceCode field.
Valid values are 01-99.

ChannelId.description: The Channel ID agreed with Royal Mail for the offline barcodes. If no value is sent in the request then the Channel ID assigned in SAPIENT will be used.

RoyalMailGetOfflineBarcodingRequest.description: Royal Mail Get Offline Barcoding Request

ChannelId.description: The Channel ID sent in the request, If none was sent in the request, then it will be populated with the Channel Id assigned in the system to the customer account.

EoriNumber.description:
Importer of Record's Economic Operators and Registration Identification (EORI) number.
Importer EORI number starts with the ISO Alpha-2 Country Code followed by a maximum 15 alphanumeric characters. For Northern Ireland, EORI numbers start with XI.

VatNumber.description: Importer of Record's Value Added Tax (VAT) number.

RoyalMailImporter.description:
This object provides specifics about the importer of record for a shipment, especially when the importer of record is not the same as the receiver. This object can include essential information such as the importer's name, address, EORI number, and VAT number, which are necessary for customs processing.

***Note:** For certain commercial shipments with DDP incoterms, even if the receiver and the importer are the same, this object is required.*

RoyalMailLabelFormat.description:
Sets the label format that will be returned in the createShipment Response.
Valid values are:
**PDF** - returns a Base64-encoded PDF
**PNG** - returns a Base64-enconded PNG
**ZPL203DPI** - returns Base 64 encoded text for Zebra printer at 203 DPI
**ZPL300DPI** - returns Base 64 encoded text for Zebra printer at 300 DPI
**DATASTREAM** - returns the label elements such as tracking URL, barcode number, 2D barcode image etc. for the label to be created in your own system, rather than returning a label image
**PDF4X3** - returns a Base64-encoded 4x3 format PDF
**PNG4X3** - returns a Base64-enconded 4x3 format PNG
Defaults to PDF if not populated.

ConsignmentShipmentId.description:
A unique identifier assigned to the shipment by the carrier. This ID is useful for tracking and managing the shipment throughout its transit journey and can be used in future queries or to reference the specific shipment.

***Note:** This field is only populated if a consignment service was used in the request.*

ConsignmentTrackingNumber.description:
A unique identifier assigned to the entire consignment shipment by the carrier. This number allows shippers and recipients to track the status and location of the entire shipment throughout its transit. It is useful for monitoring progress, ensuring timely delivery, and addressing any issues that may arise during transportation.

***Note:** This field is only populated if the service is a consignment service.*

ConsignmentCarrierTrackingUrl.description:
A URL link provided by the carrier that allows the shipper and recipients to access real-time tracking information about the consignment shipment. This link directs users to the carrier's website where they can view detailed status updates and current location of the shipment.

***Note:** This field is only populated if this feature is available and the service is a consignment service.*

Labels.description:
Returns the generated shipping labels for the shipment. This field is populated only if the requested action was "Process." The labels include the necessary barcodes and shipping information required for effective transit and delivery of the packages.

***Note:** This field has the following reservations:
  • This field returns the labels only if the **ReturnLabelsAtPackageLevel** field is set to false.
  • In addition to the shipping label, this field also returns the ID8000 label for Class 9 hazardous products—provided that the **PrintId8000Label** field in the request parameters is set to true.*

Packages.description: An array that details information about each package included in the shipment. This includes essential data, such as package occurrence and tracking information. Each package is clearly documented to facilitate tracking and handling.

Documents.description: This object is only returned if the shipment is dutiable and the requested action was "Process."  This object includes any requisite documentation necessary for customs clearance and compliance, ensuring that all regulatory requirements are met for international shipments.

ShipmentId.description: A unique identifier assigned to the shipment by the carrier for which the label is requested. This reaffirms the specific shipment being referenced.

TrackingNumber.description: A unique number assigned to the shipment that allows both the sender and the receiver to track the shipment's status and location throughout its transit. This number is essential for monitoring the delivery progress.

CarrierTrackingUrl.description: A URL link provided by the carrier that directs users to a webpage where they can track the shipment in real-time. This link provides detailed status updates and visibility into the shipment's journey.

Label.description: The generated base64-encoded string of the shipping label in the format requested in the **LabelFormat** field. This label includes essential shipping information, barcodes, and addresses, necessary for the proper handling and delivery of the shipment.

ReturnLabelsAtPackageLevel.description:
A boolean field that provides customers with the choice to generate labels at the package level instead of the shipment level. When set to true, the system returns labels for each individual package contained within the shipment.
This field is currently only supported for Royal Mail shipments.

***Note**: This field is ignored if the **Action** field is populated with values other than **Process**. By default, this field is set to false.*

ServiceCode.description: A valid unique code identifying the service selected for the shipment's delivery, which determines pricing, delivery speed, and other service attributes.

DescriptionOfGoods.description: A general description of the items being shipped, which may include details such as type, quantity, and specifications. This field provides clarity about the contents for customs and handling purposes.

ShipmentDate.description: The scheduled date for the shipment to be shipped, which cannot be in the past and must not exceed 28 days into the future. If omitted, it defaults to the current date.

DeclaredValue.description: The declared monetary value assigned to the shipment in the specified currency. If provided, it must equal or exceed the sum of all item values. If not provided, it defaults to the sum of all item values.

DeclaredWeight.description:
The total weight of the shipment in the unit of measure specified in the **WeightUnitOfMeasure** field. This weight should meet or exceed the weight of all packages or items and is required for consignment services. The minimum allowed weight is 0.001 Kg and the maximum is dependent on the carrier, service, and destination.

***Note:** For all Non-Consignment Services, use the declared weight at the package level instead.*

CurrencyCode.description: The three-letter ISO code indicating the currency in which any monetary value is specified (for example, USD, EUR). This ensures clarity for payment and invoicing purposes.

ContainerId.description:
A unique identifier assigned by the system to the container in a shipment, so that the shipment can be added to the existing container when the shipment is created.

If a valid **ContainerId** is specified, the shipments in the request will be automatically allocated to that container upon creation.If the **ContainerId** is provided, then the **Process** action is required.

***Note:** The container must already exist for the same Carrier and Shipping Location as the shipment.*

RoyalMailLabelFormatShipmentInformation.description: Used to provide shipment-level information such as service code, content type, general goods description, total shipment weight and value etc.

ShippingLocationId.description:
A unique identifier for the shipping location assigned by the system or by you (alias), allowing users to reference and manage specific locations effectively.

***Note:** The information provided in this field and the ShippingAccountId field are being linked with each other.*

PostingLocationCode.description:
Posting Location Code
The number assigned to this Location by Royal Mail.

ObaAccessCode.description:
OBA Access Code
A password for the account to access the OBA services.
A Royal Mail shipping account cannot be active unless the OBA Access code has been provided.

ReceivingHubCode.description:
Receiving Hub Code
Receiving Hub/Regional Distribution Center used for this Shipping Location.
Must be an existing receiving hub code.
Please refer to Royal Mail ReceivingHubs for a list of possible receiving hubs.
If the receiving hub is not provided, we will match it to the one that corresponds to the postcode of the location's address.

RegisteredBillingPostcode.description:
The postcode associated with the billing address for the shipping account.
This postcode is used by Royal Mail for sending invoices and other relevant billing communications related to the account.
*
**Note:** This field is mandatory when the shipping account does not have a registered billing postcode.*

RoyalMailLinkShippingAccountLocation.description: Royal Mail Link Shipping Account Location

PackageOccurrence.description:
This is used to assign barcodes to the packages.
If provided, each package occurrence must be unique.

TrackingNumber.description: The tracking number to use for the shipment. This will be mandatory for all services that require a 1D barcode.

UniqueId.description:
A unique identifier that is used for tracking packages in the Royal Mail system. This field accepts one of two options: a 21 character unique identifier or an 8 character number.

For offline barcode customers, it is imperative that only the 21 character unique identifier is provided, starting with '2B'. Offline barcoding customers must not provide an 8 character ID under any circumstances.
When submitting an update to the Royal Mail create shipment request, ensure that the UniqueId is correctly formatted to avoid any processing errors.

RoyalMailOfflineBarcode.description:
The Offline Barcode element is used to create a shipment record for a shipment that had a tracking number allocated outside of SAPIENT.
Offline Barcoding is only available if it has been activated on your customer account in the GUI.
If the Offline Barcode information is provided, then Process is the only valid action accepted in the Action field.
"OfflineBarcode" has been deprecated. Please use "OfflineBarcodes" instead.

RoyalMailOfflineBarcodingEnhancementCode.description:
The only valid values are Signed or null.
Signed - a signature is required on delivery of the shipment. Can be used with 24, 48, 1st Class and 2nd Class services.

PackageOccurrence.description:
A unique identifier for each package within the shipment that is used to match a returned package ID to this package. This field can also be used to assign items to a specific package.

***Note:** If multiple packages exist and a consignment service is not used, this field is mandatory to ensure each package occurrence is distinct.*

DeclaredWeight.description:
The total weight of the package being declared in the unit of measure specified in the WeightUnitOfMeasure field.

***Note:** The minimum allowed weight is 0.001 kg and the maximum weight is dependent on the carrier, service and destination.This field is mandatory for shipments using non-consignment services.*

DeclaredValue.description:
The declared monetary value of the package specified in the **CurrencyCode** field.

***Note:** If provided, then the declared value must meet or exceed the sum of all item values assigned to this package.Otherwise, it defaults to this sum.This value can be used for non-consignment services, though it is not mandatory.*

RoyalMailPackageTypeCode.description:
The package type used for the shipment.
Defaults to largest package type for the requested service, if not provided.

PartnerName.description: The name of the partner where partners carrier used to deliver the shipment, if applicable.

PartnerCode.description: The code of the partner carrier used to deliver the shipment is applicable.

PartnerTrackingNumber.description:

ServiceLevel.description:
The Royal Mail service level of the service specified in the ServiceCode field.

EbayVtn.description: The eBay Virtual Tracking Number. This should be provided for all shipments that relate to orders created on eBay, so that the shipment tracking data can be made available on eBay.

ServiceEnhancements.description:

Any enhancements that you would like to add to the requested service.
A maximum of 4 service enhancements can be used per shipment.

OfflineBarcodes.description:
The Offline Barcodes element is to create shipment records for shipments that had a tracking number allocated outside of SAPIENT.
Offline Barcoding is only available if it has been activated on your customer account in the GUI.
If Offline Barcodes information is provided, then Process is the only valid action accepted in the Action field.

PreAllocatedTrackingNumber.description: The pre-allocated tracking number to use for the shipment. Shipping Account, Shipping Location, Service Code, Destination Country and Postcode where required for the Country of Destination must match the one sent when the pre-allocation barcode was requested.

TermsOfDelivery.description:
Can only be populated if the value in the Incoterms field is DDP.
When the shipment Incoterm is DDP, this field can be used to specify an additional Delivery Term that will be applied to the shipment.
Accepted values: DTP, blank.

EnhancedCustomsInformation.description: Used to provide additional customs data for an item SKU code that is also provided in the Items object, when the enhanced data is applicable to the item being shipped.

RoyalMailShipmentRequestCarrierSpecifics.description: Royal Mail-specific features that can be used when creating a Royal Mail shipment.

Packages.description:
Used to provide information on the packages that are being sent in this shipment.

***Note:** You must add at least one package to the shipment.You can add a maximum of 50 packages in a single shipment.If the number of packages exceeds 50, an error will be returned, and the shipment will not be created.*

Items.description:
Used to provide information on the individual goods/products being shipped within the package. This includes vital details, such as SKU code for inventory tracking, quantity of each item, description for clarity, and shipping specifics like weight, customs classifications (HS Code), and country of origin.

***Note:** The item information is only required for dutiable shipments.Non-Dutiable and Documents Only (DOX) shipments do not require item information. Please be advised that the item verification on a shipment is done via Hurricane services; therefore, it should be enabled.The maximum number of distinct items that will be verified in a single shipment is 15.*

UniqueId.description:

PackageOccurrence.description: Identifies the sequential number or occurrence of the package provided in the request for the shipment. It allows for easy differentiation of multiple packages and helps manage inventory or logistics operations related to the shipment.

TrackingNumber.description: The specific tracking number assigned to the package occurrence by the carrier. This number can be used to track the package's status and location during its transit.

CarrierTrackingUrl.description:

***Note:** This field is only populated, if this feature is available.*

Label.description: This field provides the Base64-encoded label for each package in the shipment only if the **ReturnLabelsAtPackageLevel** field is set to True. If **ReturnLabelsAtPackageLevel** is not specified, or is set to False, then this field will not be returned, and instead, the main body of the Create Shipment response will include the label data.

ShipmentId.description:
A unique identifier associated with the specific shipment containing the package. This ID is crucial for linking the package to its overall shipment, aiding in organisation and tracking.

***Note:** This field is only populated if the service is a non-consignment service.*

AddressId.description:
A unique identifier for the address. This information ensures that each address can be distinctly referenced and managed within the system.

***Note:** If this information is provided, then all the fields under the **Address** object are ignored and the stored address in the **Address Book** will be used.*

PudoId.description:
A unique identifier for a PUDO location. This ID is retrieved from the LocationId field of the Get PUDO Locations endpoint response and is essential for identifying the specific collection point for a Royal Mail shipment.
Note: Before providing the PudoId, keep in mind the following:
- The PudoId is only applicable for destination addresses when the shipment is being created as a collection shipment. Royal Mail does not utilise this ID for drop-off shipments.
- The destination contact name must be provided with either its contact email or phone number.
- The LocalCollect supplement code is not required - the system will automatically assign the relevant supplement codes based on the PudoId.

ContactName.description:
The name of the primary contact person for the shipment at the address.

***Note:** Either the **Contact Name** or **Company Name** must be provided.*

CompanyName.description:
The name of the company associated with the shipment at the address.

***Note:** Either the **Contact Name** or **Company Name** must be provided.*

ContactEmail.description: The email address of the contact person for any communication regarding the shipment at the address.

Line1.description:
The first line of the address, typically containing the primary address information such as house number and street name.

***Note:** Characters like +, /, -, or space are supported.*

Line2.description: An optional second line for the address, often used for additional details like apartment numbers or suite designations.

Line3.description: A third optional line in the address to include any further address specifications, allowing for more detailed address information if necessary.

Town.description:
The town or city, indicating the specific locality where the shipping location is situated.

***Note:** This information is required if the address is not used from the stored addresses in the **Address Book**.*

Postcode.description:
The postal or ZIP code corresponding to the shipping location, used for mail sorting and to identify specific geographic areas.

***Note:** This information is only required for the addresses in the UK and for some outside it. To check for the postcode requirements, refer to the **Countries** API.*

County.description:
The county, state, or province in which the shipping location resides, providing additional geographical context for the address.

***Note:** This information may be required depending on the country. If the country is USA, Australia, or Canada, then it must be a valid state code or name, respectively. To check for the county/state/province requirements, refer to the **Countries** API.*

CountryCode.description:
An abbreviation representing the country of the shipping location, following the ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 standard, for example, "GB" for the United Kingdom.

***Note**: This information is only required if the address is not used from the stored addresses in the **Address Book***

What3Words.description: A three-word location identifier provided by the What3words service, offering a precise way to define locations using a unique combination of three words, for example, the front door of 10 Downing Street in London is identified by slurs.this.shark.

ShippingLocationId.description:

***Note:** This field is mandatory if more than one shipping location is available for the shipping account.*

Reference1.description:

***Note:** This information may be required based on the customer account settings in the GUI.*

Reference2.description: An optional field that allows for additional identifying information that assists in shipment tracking and referencing.

DepartmentNumber.description:

If provided for a Royal Mail shipment, Department Number must be exactly 10 characters and must be an existing Department Number that has been setup with Royal Mail.

EoriNumber.description:
The EORI (Economic Operators Registration and Identification) number for the shipper, which must start with the ISO Alpha-2 Country Code followed by up to 15 alphanumeric characters. For Northern Ireland, it starts with XI.

***Note:** Make sure to provide this information here—not in the Customs object. This field is mandatory for B2B shipments from Great Britain to Northern Ireland.*

VatNumber.description:
The VAT (Value Added Tax) number for the shipper, which is required for business transactions, helping to ensure compliance with tax regulations.

***Note:** Make sure to provide this information here—not in the Customs object.*

TermsOfTrade.description:
Specifies the International Commercial Terms (Incoterms) applicable to the shipment, governing responsibilities and financial obligations.

Valid values include the following:
  • **DDU** — Delivered Duty Unpaid.The receiver is responsible for paying customs duties and taxes.
  • **DDP** — Delivered Duty Paid.The seller is responsible for paying customs duties and taxes.
  • **DAP** — Delivered At Place.The receiver is responsible for paying customs duties and taxes.
  • **DAT** — Delivered At Terminal.The receiver is responsible for paying customs duties and taxes.

***Note:** By default, this field is set to DDU if not provided for dutiable shipments. Please be advised that this information is not required for non-dutiable shipments.*

tags.name: International Arrivals Containers
tags.description:
An international arrivals container is a way of grouping specific shipments together ready for manifesting, specific for Royal Mail.

This section provides information relating to creating and managing containers and their associated shipments prior to manifesting

Note: It is not mandatory to develop the Container API, however this feature might help if you need to manifest certain groups of shipments separate from the rest of the shipments you produced that day i.e. you might want to create a container for Royal Mail's collection at 2PM, and than have a separate container for collection at 3PM. By placing all the individual shipments into a container this allows you to manifest unlimited numbers of shipments.
